query: I want to build a new skill from scratch that teaches the agent our release checklist. Walk me through it.
note: Create a skill from scratch — the primary create path in the description.

query: The description on my log-triage skill almost never fires. Tune it so it actually triggers when it should.
note: Optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy — named verbatim in the description.

query: Write an eval set for this skill and run it so I can see the trigger rate on positives and near-misses.
note: Run evals to test a skill — the eval-authoring/running path.

query: This SKILL.md has ballooned to 900 lines and repeats itself three times. Restructure and tighten it.
note: Modify and improve an existing skill — edit path, no 'skill-creator' keyword needed.

query: Benchmark my skill across several runs — I need to know if the score moved or if that's just run-to-run variance.
note: Benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, called out explicitly in the description.

query: I keep pasting the same twelve-step incident triage instructions into every new session. Package it once so it loads on its own when the topic comes up.
note: User needs skill authoring without ever saying 'skill' — recurring instructions that should become a triggered artifact.

query: Two of my skills keep stealing each other's queries. Fix the frontmatter so each one only fires on its own domain.
note: Triggering disambiguation between skills = description optimization, the eval-driven loop.

query: help me make a skill
note: Bare informal phrasing of the core create intent — must still land.

query: Turn this markdown runbook into a proper skill with valid frontmatter and split the long tables into reference files.
note: Converting existing prose into a packaged skill = authoring/packaging.

query: How well does my skill actually perform? Measure it and tell me which part of the body is dragging the score down.
note: Measure skill performance — the measurement half of the description.

query: Use the docx skill to turn these notes into a formatted report.
note: USING a skill, not authoring one — the word 'skill' appears but the work is document generation.

query: Add a /deploy-staging slash command that takes an environment argument and calls the deploy script.
note: Slash commands are a different artifact type with a different format; skill-creator authors skills, not commands.

query: Create a subagent that reviews diffs and returns severity-tagged findings with a restricted tool allowlist.
note: Authoring an agent, not a skill — same repo family, different artifact and frontmatter schema.

query: Run humanizer over this blog draft and strip the AI tells.
note: Invoking an existing skill by name is not creating or improving one.

query: Rewrite the body of this skill so it stops reading like an LLM wrote it — too many em dashes and rule-of-three lists.
note: Strong trap: the object IS a skill file, but the requested transformation is de-AI-ifying prose, which is humanizer's job.

query: Draft a technical proposal for how our team should standardize agent tooling, and iterate on it with me section by section.
note: Structured document co-authoring — adjacent subject matter (agent tooling) but the deliverable is a doc, not a skill.

query: Cut your responses way down, I'm burning tokens too fast.
note: Token-efficiency request, not skill authoring.

query: Build an MCP server that exposes our ticketing API as tools the model can call.
note: Authoring a different kind of agent capability — an MCP server, not a skill.

query: Which skill should I use to pull typography values out of a Figma frame?
note: Skill SELECTION question — answering it means using figma, not creating or optimizing a skill.

query: Install the example-skills plugin and wire the marketplace into this repo so the skills load.
note: Installation and plugin configuration — consuming skills, not building or evaluating them.
